verify.notes: V2195 sigcheck --only career.standings_weekend_track_done: OK hits=1 match=0x14181e4dc target=0x14181e4dc (anchor 0, expect 4885DB745D). Disasm: 0x14181e4dc test rbx,rbx; je 0x14181e53e; cmp byte [r12+0x49],0; je 0x14181e53e; mov rax,[rbx+0x128], so the path checks rbx before any read through it. Branches to it: je at 0x14181e19b (the [r12+0x4a]==0 path, entered with the same registers and frame as the guarded site, since the cmp/je pair writes only flags), 0x14181e481 and 0x14181e48e, plus the fall-through of the call at 0x14181e4d7; the .xtls rel32 scan finds no other. Past 0x14181e53e rbx is reloaded (lea rbx,[rsp+0x1b8] at 0x14181e571/0x14181e5a2/0x14181e5b4) before use, so resuming here with rbx 0 is the game's own no-record path.
